newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling stable in lucklustre trading.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling stable in lucklustre trading.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling held stable on Friday in lucklustre trading, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.93 unchanged against the dollar while against the pound it was posted at a mean rate of 88.71 from 88.63.
"The shilling is range-bound. There's very little movement because whatever inflows are coming are being absorbed," a dealer said.

The shilling was unchanged for the fourth day on Friday. Dealers said it was likely it would close the week at the same levels as the majority of players sought to square their positions ahead of the weekend.
The money market remained liquid. Overnight rates were quoted as high as 12 percent compared to 10-15 percent on Thursday.
